task.title: Inventory legacy closed work against production-ready gates
task.summary: Audit closed legacy CodeWiki runtime, daemon, agency, worktree, gateway, and tool-surface work against the new production-ready closure policy, then create remediation tasks only for concrete gaps.

goal.outcome: Closed legacy work is reconciled against the new production-ready policy without rewriting history, and only evidence-backed remediation work is added to the roadmap.
acceptance: Inventory closed tasks/sprints that touched daemon/runtime, agency, worktree/session, gateway/policy, roadmap, state, command/tool surfaces, or other production-surface foundations before SPRINT-019.

For each candidate, assess whether current code has executable behavior tests, relevant linter/gateway evidence, validation reports, content evidence, and code/KB alignment sufficient under the new production-ready closure semantics.
Record each candidate as production-ready, needs-remediation, deferred-until-SPRINT-019-gate, or not-applicable with source refs and rationale.

Create or refine remediation tasks only for concrete gaps, grouped by capability and with direct acceptance criteria; do not reopen or mutate historical closed tasks as if their original closure status were wrong.
If the new SPRINT-019 gates are not implemented yet, record blocked/deferred evidence instead of pretending the legacy work can pass the future gate today.
Produce an implementation_build or planning/reconciliation build that summarizes inventory findings, remediation task ids, deferrals, and no-gap evidence.
Run planning/task-close validation for the inventory result using available linters and source refs.
non_goals: Do not reopen closed tasks or rewrite their historical closure evidence.
Do not implement daemon/runtime/agency/gateway fixes in this inventory task.
Do not create broad umbrella remediation tasks without concrete evidence-backed gaps.
Do not treat absence of not-yet-implemented SPRINT-019 gates as a retroactive failure of old tasks.
Do not publish, release, push, or perform destructive actions.
verification: targeted existing smoke tests only if the inventory claims a capability is production-ready
wiki_gate task-close or planning gate for the inventory result with source refs and gap/remediation evidence

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
